defect: Fabricated sensor-validation claims (P0-F): historical phase-L validation runs recorded rgb/depth/semantic_segmentation/lidar/gnss/imu as CAPTURED with gnss_agreement=PASS and synchronization_status=PASS without spawning any sensor rig or capturing any frame. The producer code at this base SHA is fail-closed (phase_l_validation.py, step_l9_sensor_validation, lines 510-546: claims retired with reason 'no sensor rig spawned and no frames captured by this run'), but the historical evidence artifacts remain on disk as false-positive receipts.
action: Revoked in place; artifacts are preserved (never overwritten) and are excluded from all acceptance chains. Any artifact claiming map-dependent sensor validation produced before the P0 map repair must be regenerated against the repaired candidate with a live CARLA runtime.

producer_fix_evidence.scope: root-level phase-L validation harness tracked at base SHA 837a8504
producer_fix_evidence.behavior: fail-closed: L9 returns status NOT_RUN / NOT_CAPTURED with explicit retirement reason; no CAPTURED/PASS can be emitted without a live runtime

negative_control: Required before acceptance: invoke a sensor-validation claim path with no runtime and assert the result is NOT_RUN / FAIL (never CAPTURED/PASS).
map_dependency_note: GNSS agreement against the map georeference additionally depends on P0-E (absolute origin). A truthful GNSS re-validation can only run after the georeference-carrying candidate is loaded in CARLA.
